snippet.title: QBIX Game | Fright Maze Trailer
snippet.description:
Fright Maze is a heart-pounding, intense escape adventure made for QBIX! It's for up to 6 players, and guests become elite soldiers on their mission and navigate through a dark maze full of creatures.
Learn more about QBIX, the 6-Player Immersive Gaming Room at www.inowize.com/qbix
